content.title: About
content.content: The Chicken Fillet Sandwich (NFS 1773) is a ready‑to‑eat sandwich consisting of tender chicken fillet, fresh vegetables, a yogurt‑based sauce and a soft whole‑grain bun. It is designed for quick meals at the office, school or on the go.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sandwich is part of the NFS line – products created for convenient nutrition without cooking.
The chicken fillet is thermally processed at a minimum of 75 °C, ensuring safety.
The bun is made from whole‑grain flour, increasing dietary fiber content.
The sauce is yogurt‑based, lowering calories compared with traditional mayonnaise sauces.
The product has a shelf life of 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken fillet provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with typical sandwiches, this product contains less saturated fat, supporting cardiovascular health.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken meat and whole‑grain bun supply vitamins B6 and B12, important for metabolism.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: The whole‑grain bun adds fiber, aiding normal digestion.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: No added sugars make this sandwich suitable for blood‑glucose management.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt used in the sauce and marination can increase overall sodium intake.

items.title: Storage requirements
items.content: Improper storage (moisture, high temperature) may cause spoilage.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: The product may contain food preservatives that can affect sensitive consumers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is ready to eat straight from the package. If desired, heat in a microwave for 30‑40 seconds to soften the bun and warm the fillet.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place at 10 °C–25 °C. After opening, consume within 3‑5 days.
